This '''Sith artifact''' was located in [[Unidentified Muzara ruins|ruins]] accessible only through the larger complex of [[Kabus-Dabeh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]].<ref name="EA">{{WEGCite|story=Evil Arisen|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref> Sometime around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and followers of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] traveled to Muzara to recover the [[Force artifact/Legends|artifact]]. A group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] was alerted to their activities by the local [[Muza]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]], who urged them to stop the strangers. The Jedi followed the offworlders and confronted them, stopping them from using the artifact to bring evil to the [[Muzara system/Legends|Muzara system]].<ref name="EA" />
